THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Ref No.: Kadu/Ath/123(UDA). I hereby give notice, under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
